allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.name: Verify reference data and scan integrity
allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.run: node --test tests/*.test.mjs

allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.name: Verify preserved citation evidence
allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/citation-evidence-seals
evidence_base="$EVIDENCE_BASE_SHA"
if [ -z "$evidence_base" ] || [ "$evidence_base" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
  evidence_base="$(git rev-parse HEAD^)"
fi
set +e
node tools/citation-evidence-seals.mjs --check --manifest research/citation-evidence-seals.json --baseline-ref "$evidence_base" > artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/report.json 2> artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/errors.txt
evidence_status=$?
set -e
echo "$evidence_status" > artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/validation-exit-status.txt
cat artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/report.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
cat artifacts/citation-evidence-seals/errors.txt
exit "$evidence_status"

allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.name: Verify committed static output is current
allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.run:
node tools/assemble.mjs
git diff --exit-code -- dist

allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.name: Generate citation systemic inventory
allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.run:
set +e
node tools/citation-systemic-inventory.mjs --output-dir artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage
report_status=$?
set -e
if [ -f artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage/citation-systemic-summary.md ]; then
  sed -n '1,35p' artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage/citation-systemic-summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
else
  mkdir -p artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage
  echo "Citation systemic inventory unavailable: generator exited before writing its summary (status ${report_status})." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  echo "Generator did not write citation-systemic-summary.md (exit status ${report_status})." > artifacts/citation-systemic-coverage/generation-error.txt
  if [ "$report_status" -eq 0 ]; then report_status=1; fi
fi
exit "$report_status"

allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.name: Verify citation owner identity

allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.name: Verify monetary source inventory
allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.run:
set +e
node tools/monetary-source-inventory.mjs --check research/monetary-source-inventory.json
monetary_status=$?
set -e
mkdir -p artifacts/monetary-source-inventory
if [ -f research/monetary-source-inventory.json ]; then cp research/monetary-source-inventory.json artifacts/monetary-source-inventory/; fi
echo "$monetary_status" > artifacts/monetary-source-inventory/validation-exit-status.txt
echo "The monetary inventory preserves source occurrences, package quantities, unresolved pointers and separate XP values. Its declared source scopes do not certify whole-book completeness." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
exit "$monetary_status"

allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.name: Verify recorded monetary row identity findings
allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/monetary-row-identity
set +e
node tools/monetary-findings-register.mjs --check > artifacts/monetary-row-identity/finding-register.json
register_status=$?
node tools/monetary-row-identity-audit.mjs --output artifacts/monetary-row-identity/report.json --check > artifacts/monetary-row-identity/summary.json
row_status=$?
set -e
echo "$register_status" > artifacts/monetary-row-identity/finding-register-exit-status.txt
echo "$row_status" > artifacts/monetary-row-identity/validation-exit-status.txt
echo "Known monetary findings require exact current independent dispositions. New duplicate-focus candidates and source ambiguities remain visible; a clean structural check does not certify source completeness." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
cat artifacts/monetary-row-identity/finding-register.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
cat artifacts/monetary-row-identity/summary.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
if [ "$register_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$register_status"; fi
exit "$row_status"

allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.name: Check class advancement and source qualifiers
allRequiredBuildValidationBlocks.run:
mkdir -p artifacts/source-domain-audits
set +e
node tools/class-progression-audit.mjs --input dist/data.json --output artifacts/source-domain-audits/class-progression.json --check
class_status=$?
node tools/source-qualifier-coverage.mjs --input dist/data.json --output artifacts/source-domain-audits/source-qualifiers.json --check
qualifier_status=$?
node tools/ua26-note-marker-audit.mjs > artifacts/source-domain-audits/ua26-note-markers.json

set -e
